world_gradient_illumination — SEGMENTATION world op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.world_gradient_illumination(seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(160, 220), n_objects: 'int' = 8, gradient=(0.45, 0.2), i0: 'float' = 0.3, reflectance: 'float' = 0.35, noise: 'float' = 0.03) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segworld; segworld.world_gradient_illumination(seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(160, 220), n_objects: 'int' = 8, gradient=(0.45, 0.2), i0: 'float' = 0.3, reflectance: 'float' = 0.35, noise: 'float' = 0.03) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("world_gradient_illumination"))

Usage

World of dark objects over an illumination gradient plus noise (global thresholding breaks; local thresholding / flat-field cut it) (world_gradient_illumination).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

I(x, y) = i0 + g_x x/(W−1) + g_y y/(H−1)(i0 + g_x + g_y ≤ 1)、画像 = I · R + 雑音。R = 背景 1、物体 reflectance。物体は円(半径 8〜14)と整数辺の矩形(14〜28)、互いに離す。

返り値: image、labels(1..n)、illumination、reflectance_map、truth = {n_objects、objects(kind, params)、areas(πr² / w h)、i0、gradient、reflectance、noise}。
